skills.name: lookalike-domains
skills.description: Finds lookalike domains of a real domain (IDN homograph and homoglyph domains made with confusable characters) and says which are registered, live, parked or able to receive email, using the free d0ma1n.app API. Use when someone asks whether their brand or domain is being impersonated, wants a list of homoglyph, homograph or punycode lookalike domains, is checking a suspicious link or email sender domain (such as paypal.com spelt with a Cyrillic а), or is writing a phishing, typosquatting or brand-protection report. Also reads a suspicious domain back to the real domain it imitates.
